id: title:jurajmajerik:enable mcp tools for prompt experiments

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration allowing users to create experiments and retrieve prompt templates, and includes a permission check before creation.
review.reason: The chunk adds a permission check at P1.F1.H1 and three new MCP tool handlers and registrations at P1.F7.H2, P1.F7.H3, and P1.F7.H4. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it establishes a new workflow for users to interact with the PostHog backend via an external MCP client, including authentication and resource discovery. review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the permission check, serializer, view, database models, API endpoints, OpenAPI spec, and generated TypeScript client. Therefore, while the registration and tool definitions are present, the actual execution and backend enforcement are not demonstrated in this chunk. The benefit relies on unverified backend implementation and complete MCP setup

observations.behavior: Adds a permission check before creating an experiment from a prompt.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the user has access to the LLM prompt resource before attempting to create an experiment, preventing unauthorized access. This could prevent privilege escalation or unauthorized use of LLM resources.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new tool handler 'experiment-create-from-prompt' that accepts prompt_name, versions, templates, name, feature_flag_key, description, and calls the backend endpoint '/experiments/create_from_prompt/'. P1.F7.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Adds an MCP tool allowing users to create an experiment from an LLM prompt, including prompt-specific parameters and metric templates.

observations.behavior: Adds a new tool handler 'experiment-prompt-templates' that fetches prompt templates. P1.F7.H3
observations.posthog_connection: Adds an MCP tool to retrieve available prompt templates, supporting the workflow of selecting a prompt before creation.

observations.behavior: Registers the new experiment-create-from-prompt tool in the GENERATED_TOOLS export. P1.F7.H4
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the new tool available to the MCP client.
